about: Susan S. Minamizono attended law school and graduated from University of San Diego School of Law in 2008. Susan Minamizono began practicing law in 2008.
Susan Minamizono is an attorney at Levin Sitcoff PC, helping people with Insurance Coverage issues. Levin Sitcoff PC has an office in Denver, Colorado, serving the local community.

Susan Minamizono was selected to Super Lawyers for 2019 - 2027. Super Lawyers is an exclusive list of top-rated attorneys in specific practice areas who were chosen after thorough evaluation of numerous criteria.

The Super Lawyers patented selection process is peer influenced and research driven, selecting the top 5% of attorneys to the Super Lawyers lists each year. We know lawyers and make it easy to connect with them.
